cards.explanation: The answer is the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. The sisters approach it and stand before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the leaders, and the whole congregation (Numbers 27:2). Then they speak up and make their case. Five sisters, one entrance, and a whole congregation to hear it. I respect that a whole lot, friends.

The answer is False. The sisters say their father "…was not among the followers of Korah who gathered together against the LORD." (Numbers 27:3). Korah's rebellion was a big, loud mess (Numbers 16:1-3), and they made sure their dad's name stayed out of it. Then they said he died because of his own sin, and they didn't dodge that either, friends.

The answer is property among their father's brothers. They say, "Give us property among our father’s brothers." (Numbers 27:4). Their dad had no sons, and they didn't want his name to disappear from his clan. Five sisters, one clear request, no rambling. I've seen grown folks take twenty minutes to ask for a napkin.

The answer is that Moses brings it before the LORD. "…Moses brought their case before the LORD…" (Numbers 27:5). Five sisters had just made their request, and Moses took it to the LORD. I think that's the right move when a question is that big, friends. The LORD answers him in the very next verse (Numbers 27:6).

The answer is True. The LORD says, "The daughters of Zelophehad speak correctly." (Numbers 27:7). Five sisters stood up in front of everybody, and the LORD agreed with them. I think that's the kind of sentence you'd frame and hang over the oven, bakers.

The answer is inheritance. The LORD says to give them property "…and transfer their father’s inheritance to them." (Numbers 27:7). That's what the sisters came asking for, friends. Their father's inheritance goes to his daughters, right there among their father's brothers.

The answer is his daughter. "If a man dies and leaves no son, you are to transfer his inheritance to his daughter." (Numbers 27:8). The sisters had asked for property among their father's brothers, and here the LORD tells Moses to say this to the Israelites. It becomes a rule for the whole nation, not just one family. I think those five sisters standing at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting got an answer bigger than their question, friends.

The answer is brothers. "If he has no daughter, give his inheritance to his brothers." (Numbers 27:9). The LORD's rule goes in order, friends: son first, then daughter, then brothers. And the order keeps going, because the next verse covers what happens if there are no brothers (Numbers 27:10).

The answer is False. When there are no children, no brothers, and no brothers of the father, the LORD says, "…give his inheritance to the next of kin from his clan…" (Numbers 27:11). It stays in the clan, not with another tribe, friends. That's the last step in the list the LORD gives.
